# `aitbc monitor dashboard`

Show a real-time system dashboard with service status.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc monitor dashboard [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--refresh` | integer | `5` | no | Refresh interval in seconds |
| `--duration` | integer | `0` | no | Duration in seconds (0 = indefinite) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc monitor dashboard
```
